description: Confluence-to-Notion Chrome Extension V1 - manually save one Confluence Server/Data Center page into a selected Notion database or page with storage-format conversion and asset upload.

userStories.title: Scaffold MV3 TypeScript extension
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Chrome Extension MV3 project scaffold so future stories can add app logic safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add package manifest and lockfile for a TypeScript Chrome Extension build

Add MV3 manifest with popup, options page, background service worker, storage permission, notifications permission, tabs permission, activeTab permission, and optional host permissions empty by default
Add source folders for popup, options, background, shared domain, Confluence, Notion, converter, assets, and tests
Add scripts for build, typecheck, and test
Build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented TypeScript MV3 scaffold with build, typecheck, and test scripts.

userStories.title: Define domain model and storage schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need typed domain entities and persisted settings contracts that match the spec.
acceptanceCriteria: Define types for ConfluencePageRef, ConfluencePageData, NotionTarget, ClipTask, AssetRef, and Degradation
Define ClipTask statuses exactly as idle, detecting, fetching, parsing, converting, uploading_assets, writing, succeeded, failed, cancelled
Define storage keys for Notion auth state, workspace info, default target, Confluence base URL, active ClipTask lock, and last terminal ClipTask summary
Add unit tests for ClipTask terminal status helpers and storage key constants
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Defined core domain models, ClipTask statuses/helpers, storage key constants, and tests.

userStories.title: Implement Chrome storage boundary helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I need storage helpers that keep secrets in chrome.storage.local and support logout cleanup rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement typed read/write/remove helpers for chrome.storage.local
Notion access token and refresh token are stored only through local storage helpers
Logout cleanup removes Notion tokens, workspace info, default target, and last terminal ClipTask summary
Logout cleanup does not remove Confluence base URL
Add unit tests using mocked chrome.storage.local
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented typed chrome.storage.local helpers, Notion auth persistence helpers, logout cleanup, and mocked storage tests.

userStories.title: Validate and normalize Confluence base URL
userStories.description: As a user, I need the extension to accept one Confluence base URL with optional context path and reject unsafe forms.
acceptanceCriteria: Accept absolute http and https URLs with origin plus optional context path
Preserve context path and remove trailing slash during normalization
Reject URLs with query string, fragment, username, password, or unsupported scheme
Store only one active normalized Confluence base URL
Add unit tests for origin-only, context-path, trailing-slash, query, hash, credentials, and unsupported-scheme cases
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Confluence base URL validation, normalization, single active storage helper, and tests.

userStories.title: Request Confluence host permission
userStories.description: As a user, I need the extension to request only the configured Confluence origin permission before using Confluence APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement host permission request using chrome.permissions.request for the normalized base URL origin only
Changing the base URL requests the new origin permission
Changing the base URL does not actively remove old origin permission
Detection and REST fetch code can check whether current origin permission exists
Add unit tests with mocked chrome.permissions
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented origin-scoped Confluence host permission request and permission check helpers with mocked chrome.permissions tests.

userStories.title: Build Options UI for Confluence settings
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure my Confluence base URL and grant host permission from the options page.
acceptanceCriteria: Options page has Confluence base URL input, validation error display, saved normalized URL display, and grant-permission action
Saving invalid URL shows validation message and does not persist it
Saving valid URL persists normalized URL and triggers host permission request flow
UI shows whether required host permission is granted
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Built Confluence settings Options UI with validation, normalized save, host permission request/status, and DOM tests. Browser verification still needs manual/dev-browser follow-up because no browser MCP tool was available in this session.

userStories.title: Implement Notion OAuth launch and callback
userStories.description: As a user, I need to authorize Notion through OAuth without pasting an integration token.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement OAuth start flow using chrome.identity launch flow or equivalent MV3-compatible redirect flow
Exchange authorization code for access token, refresh token, workspace info, and integration bot metadata
Store Notion tokens only in chrome.storage.local
OAuth config records selected Notion API version and requested minimum scopes in code configuration
Add tests for token persistence and failed callback handling with mocked network calls
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Notion OAuth launch flow, callback handling, authorization code exchange, token/workspace persistence, OAuth config, and tests.

userStories.title: Implement Notion token refresh and logout
userStories.description: As a user, I need expired Notion tokens refreshed automatically and failed refreshes to require reauthorization.
acceptanceCriteria: Refresh expired access token before Notion API calls when refresh token exists
On refresh failure, clear Notion auth state, workspace info, default target, and last terminal ClipTask summary
On logout, clear the same Notion state and keep Confluence base URL
Never expose Notion tokens to content scripts or popup messages
Add unit tests for successful refresh, failed refresh, and logout cleanup
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Notion token refresh, authorized API fetch helper, authorization status helper, logout cleanup, and tests.

userStories.title: Discover Notion page and database targets
userStories.description: As a user, I need to search accessible Notion pages and databases and select a default save target.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement Notion target search/list API wrapper for accessible pages and databases only
Empty search/list result returns guidance to grant the integration access in Notion
Selecting a page target stores id, type page, and displayName
Selecting a database target reads database metadata and stores id, type database, displayName, and title property name or id
Add unit tests for page target, database target, empty list, and invalid target type
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Notion target search/list wrapper, empty access guidance, page target persistence, database metadata lookup with title property persistence, and invalid target validation.

userStories.title: Build Options UI for Notion settings
userStories.description: As a user, I want to connect Notion, search targets, choose a default database or page, and logout.
acceptanceCriteria: Options page shows Notion authorization status and connect/logout actions
Target picker lists searchable page and database targets returned by Notion target discovery
Database targets and page targets are both selectable and saved as default targets
Empty target list shows guidance to grant integration access in Notion
Logout clears Notion state in UI while keeping Confluence configuration visible
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Built Notion settings Options UI with authorization status, connect/logout actions, target search/list, page/database target selection, empty access guidance, and DOM tests. Browser verification still needs manual/dev-browser follow-up because no browser MCP tool was available in this session.

userStories.title: Detect supported Confluence pages
userStories.description: As a user, I need the extension to recognize supported pages only inside the configured Confluence base URL path.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect /pages/viewpage.action?pageId={pageId} URLs and extract pageId
Detect /spaces/{SPACE}/pages/{pageId} URLs and extract pageId
Detect /display/{SPACE}/{Page+Title} URLs and use DOM metadata or bootstrap data for pageId when available
Reject URLs outside the normalized base URL path even when same origin
Reject detection when host permission is missing
Add unit tests for all supported URL forms and path-guard failures
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Confluence page detection for viewpage, modern space page, and display URLs with DOM/bootstrap pageId fallback, normalized base URL path guard, host permission check, and tests.

userStories.title: Fetch Confluence storage data
userStories.description: As a user, I need the extension to fetch storage format and metadata through the Confluence REST API using browser session cookies.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch GET /rest/api/content/{pageId}?expand=body.storage,metadata.labels,version,space,children.attachment
Use fetch with credentials include and no cookies permission
Enforce normalized base URL path for REST content fetch
Map 401 and 403 to authentication or permission failure
Map 404 to page missing or inaccessible failure
Map 5xx and network errors to temporary Confluence failure
Add unit tests for request URL, credentials mode, path guard, response mapping, and metadata extraction
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Confluence REST storage fetcher with credentials include, base URL path guard, response failure mapping, metadata and attachment extraction, and tests.

userStories.title: Add request timeout and retry wrapper
userStories.description: As a user, I need external requests bounded by per-request timeouts, limited retries, and the overall ClipTask timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement 30-second per-request timeout wrapper for Confluence, asset, and Notion requests
Retry network errors, HTTP 408, HTTP 429, and HTTP 5xx at most 2 times per request
Do not retry HTTP 400, 401, 403, or 404 unless explicitly configured for a specific API
Notion 429 retry uses response retry hints when available
Retry loop respects a caller-provided overall deadline
Add unit tests with fake timers for timeout, retryable status, non-retryable status, retry limit, and deadline exhaustion
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented shared request timeout/retry wrapper and routed Confluence/Notion API fetches through it.

userStories.title: Parse Confluence storage XML safely
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a safe XML parser that preserves Confluence namespaces and blocks external entity/resource loading.
acceptanceCriteria: Parser preserves ac:* and ri:* namespace-qualified nodes in the internal AST
Parser does not execute XML, HTML, SVG, scripts, event handlers, or macro content
External entities are not resolved and no external request is made
Unsupported raw HTML is converted to recoverable plain text or a Degradation
Whole-document XML parse failure fails the task with a parse error
Add unit tests for simple XML, namespace preservation, unsupported raw HTML, malformed XML, and external entity blocking
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented safe Confluence storage XML parser with namespace-preserving AST, external entity blocking, unsupported raw HTML degradation, malformed XML parse failures, and tests.

userStories.title: Convert basic Confluence content to Notion blocks
userStories.description: As a user, I need ordinary Confluence content converted directly into Notion blocks without Markdown as the main intermediate format.
acceptanceCriteria: Convert headings, paragraphs, links, ordered lists, unordered lists, and nested lists to Notion blocks
Convert bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, and best-effort colored text to Notion rich_text
Convert basic tables to Notion table blocks when supported
Flatten or degrade complex tables without failing the whole task
Converter does not use Markdown as the main intermediate format
Add fixture test for simple profile covering headings, paragraphs, links, lists, basic table, and inline formatting
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented direct Confluence storage AST to Notion block conversion for headings, paragraphs, links, lists, inline formatting, basic tables, and complex table degradation.

userStories.title: Convert supported Confluence macros
userStories.description: As a user, I need common Confluence macros preserved with Notion-native semantics where possible.
acceptanceCriteria: Convert mermaid macro to Notion code block with language mermaid when accepted
When mermaid language is rejected, fall back to plain-text code and add warning
Convert code and noformat macros to code blocks preserving text and best-effort language
Convert info, note, tip, and warning macros to callout blocks with preserved body
Convert expand macro to toggle block with preserved title and recursive child conversion where possible
Convert unknown macro to callout text Unsupported Confluence macro: {name} plus recoverable body text without macro parameters
Add macro-heavy fixture tests for all required macro mappings and unknown macro fallback
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented macro-heavy conversion for Mermaid, code/noformat, callout macros, expand toggles, unknown macro fallback, and Mermaid language fallback warning.

userStories.title: Extract and classify Confluence assets
userStories.description: As a user, I need images, attachments, and Draw.io render assets identified before upload or fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract asset URLs from storage XML image nodes and attachment metadata
Classify Confluence-hosted asset URLs as same-origin with the configured Confluence base URL
Allow same-origin referenced assets outside the normalized base URL path
Classify cross-origin external image URLs without using Confluence credentials
Extract Draw.io rendered image candidate and optional source link when available
Add unit tests for same-origin in-path assets, same-origin outside-path assets, cross-origin assets, attachment metadata, and Draw.io extraction
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Confluence asset extraction and classification for storage XML images, attachment metadata, same-origin outside-path assets, cross-origin images, and Draw.io rendered image/source links.

userStories.title: Download and upload Notion assets
userStories.description: As a user, I need Confluence-hosted assets downloaded by the browser and uploaded to Notion with safe limits and fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Download same-origin Confluence-hosted assets with credentials include
Never download cross-origin assets with Confluence credentials
Upload supported files to Notion File Upload API with concurrency limit 3
Skip files larger than 20 MB and preserve original Confluence link as text or bookmark/link block with warning
Treat upload not attached within 1 hour as upload failure and preserve source link with warning
Do not persist Notion-hosted uploaded file URLs as durable references
Add unit tests for concurrency 3, oversized skip, download failure, upload failure, expired attach window, and credential mode
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Confluence asset processing with credentialed same-origin downloads, Notion File Upload API hooks, concurrency limit 3, oversized/cross-origin skips, source-link fallbacks, and warning degradations.

userStories.title: Render image and Draw.io fallbacks
userStories.description: As a user, I need asset failures to degrade locally without adding noisy per-image error callouts.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace uploaded assets with Notion-compatible image, file, video, audio, or pdf block references
Cross-origin external image URLs are not uploaded and become Notion external image blocks only when directly usable
Unusable cross-origin image URLs become ordinary link text or bookmark/link blocks
Failed Confluence-hosted image uploads do not become Notion external image blocks pointing at internal URLs
Draw.io import uses rendered image when available and preserves optional source link when available
No per-image error callout is added for failed assets; warning count increments instead
Add image-heavy fixture tests for attachment images, external images, broken image, and more than one image batch
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented processed asset rendering to Notion image/file/video/audio/pdf blocks, cross-origin image fallbacks, Draw.io source preservation, and warning-count behavior without per-image callouts.

userStories.title: Create Notion pages for selected target
userStories.description: As a user, I need each save to create a new Notion page under the selected database or page target.
acceptanceCriteria: Database target creates a new page in the selected database using the saved title property name or id
Page target creates a new child page under the selected page
Created page title uses the Confluence page title without pageId, timestamp, or dedupe suffix
Writer does not query historical mappings, scan Notion for duplicates, or update old clipped pages
Stale database title property, schema, or target permission failure returns target-invalid guidance
Add unit tests for database target, page target, duplicate save behavior, and stale database target failure
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Notion page creation for database and page targets with duplicate-save new-page behavior and target-invalid guidance.

userStories.title: Write metadata toggle and append blocks
userStories.description: As a user, I need clipped pages to include Confluence metadata and content written within Notion API limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Confluence metadata toggle at top of every clipped page
Metadata toggle includes Original URL, Confluence Base URL, Confluence Page ID, Confluence Space, Labels, Last Modified, and Last Clipped At
Database target does not create, modify, or depend on metadata database properties
Append blocks in batches of at most 100
On partial block append failure, do not archive, delete, clear, or reuse the partial Notion page
Partial write summary includes Notion page URL when available
Add unit tests for metadata toggle fields, 100-block batching, database property non-modification, and partial write behavior
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented clipped page writing with Confluence metadata toggle, append batching at 100 blocks, database property non-modification, and partial append failure reporting.

userStories.title: Implement background ClipTask runner
userStories.description: As a user, I need save work to run in the background and expose progress even when the popup closes.
acceptanceCriteria: Run save operation in MV3 background service worker
Allow only one non-terminal ClipTask at a time
Duplicate save click while any task is non-terminal returns existing task progress instead of starting a new Notion page
Overall ClipTask timeout is 5 minutes from task start and releases the single-task lock on failure
Persist enough non-terminal ClipTask state for service worker startup detection
On service worker startup with a persisted non-terminal task, mark it failed, release the lock, and show retry guidance
Persist only the most recent terminal ClipTask summary and overwrite it on next terminal task
Add unit tests for state transitions, duplicate save, overall timeout, startup recovery, and last-summary retention
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented MV3 background ClipTask runner with single non-terminal task lock, duplicate-save progress return, 5-minute timeout, service worker startup recovery, and last terminal summary persistence.

userStories.title: Orchestrate full save pipeline
userStories.description: As a user, I need one save action to detect, fetch, parse, convert, upload assets, write Notion, and produce a terminal summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline stages run in order: detecting, fetching, parsing, converting, uploading_assets, writing, succeeded or failed
Missing Notion auth, missing target, missing Confluence base URL, missing host permission, unsupported page, and Confluence auth failures fail early
Single macro, image, table, or asset degradation does not fail the whole task
Whole-page fetch failure, whole XML parse failure, Notion page creation failure, and exhausted append retry fail the task
Final summary includes taskId, source title and URL, Notion target, final status, elapsed time, block count, asset count, warning count, Notion page URL when created, and first failure reason
Add integration-style tests with mocked Confluence and Notion APIs for success with warnings, early failure, partial write, and repeated save creating new pages
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented full Confluence-to-Notion save pipeline orchestration with staged progress, early failures, degradation warnings, partial write summaries, and repeated-save new-page behavior.

userStories.title: Build popup save UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want the popup to show current page status, target, save progress, and final result summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Popup shows whether current tab is a supported configured Confluence page
Popup shows current Notion target and blocks save when no target is selected
Save button starts background ClipTask and does not depend on popup remaining open
While a task is running, popup shows existing task stage: fetch, parse, convert, upload images, or write
Duplicate save click shows existing progress and does not create a second task
Terminal result shows success or failure, warning count, and Notion page URL when available
Result copy makes clear that a new Notion page was created on successful save
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Built Popup save UI with current-page status, selected target display, background ClipTask start, running progress, duplicate-save progress reuse, and terminal result summaries. Browser verification still needs manual/dev-browser follow-up because no browser MCP tool was available in this session.

userStories.title: Add notifications and badge feedback
userStories.description: As a user, I need completion, failure, and retry guidance visible even if the popup is closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Show browser notification or extension badge on save success
Show browser notification or extension badge on save failure
Timeout failure notification includes retry guidance
Service worker startup recovery failure notification includes retry guidance
Notifications never include Notion tokens, refresh tokens, cookies, or authorization headers
Add unit tests for notification payload redaction and success/failure messages with mocked chrome.notifications or action badge APIs
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented ClipTask completion feedback with success/failure browser notifications, action badge state, retry guidance for timeout/startup recovery, and secret redaction tests.

userStories.title: Add developer debug logging with redaction
userStories.description: As a developer, I need structured local debug logs for troubleshooting without exposing secrets or adding debug export.
acceptanceCriteria: Developer debug logs include stage start/end, Confluence fetch status, XML parse summary, macro count by type, asset upload summary, and Notion write batch summary
Logs redact access token, refresh token, cookie values, and full Notion authorization headers
V1 has no debug export UI, command, route, or storage export feature
Debug logging is disabled or quiet by default outside development mode
Add unit tests for redaction of token, cookie, and authorization header patterns
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add release checklist verification tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automated tests and fixtures that cover the spec's required V1 validation matrix.
acceptanceCriteria: Add fixtures named simple, macro-heavy, and image-heavy using sanitized Confluence storage XML

Test matrix covers base URL normalization, supported page detection, host permission path guard, XML external entity blocking, required macro conversion, unknown macro fallback, asset concurrency, oversized assets, failed uploads, database and page targets, re-save behavior, append batching, duplicate save, logout retention, and service worker startup recovery
Test suite can run through the package test script
Build passes
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
